answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each slot anchors one identity to a walnut-sized deposit of 50 POA, locked before work starts. A rotating peer jury checks the finished work; fake work gets the deposit burned and the identity struck. Running 100 fake slots locks 5,000 POA, and each burned deposit is an ember gone for good. An honest agent risks one deposit and earns it back, so honest work stays cheap while fakery pays.
